messages:
maria: heads-up: during the private VPC deploy earlier we saw a spike in decrypt errors from the dataplane (kms:Decrypt failures). not service outage but noisy errors. digging in now. :frowning:
ajay: any quick context on which CMK? control-plane CMK or dataplane envelope CMK?
maria: looks like the dataplane DEK rewrap job kicked off for CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 and some pods started failing to decrypt cached envelopes. timing lines up with the rotation window. :confused:
sarah: oh — was that a scheduled rotation or manual? we normally stagger rotations to avoid concurrent rewraps + cache flush.
maria: scheduled, but the rotation start time was bumped earlier by an automation tweak in the ops pipeline (see CLOUD-3421). automation triggered rewraps across all shards simultaneously. that seems to have tripped in-flight cached DEKs.
leo: we should avoid a full-shard simultaneous rewrap. immediate mitigation: pause rewrap job, roll back automation change. can we pause? ops-bot: rewrap-job ID 789 paused (by ops-bot). :white_check_mark:
ajay: for remediation, two paths: 1) rewrap back to previous key version (if we have old-encrypted copies) or 2) force cache eviction + rehydrate by reading primary store which will re-encrypt with new DEK during access. option 2 is safer if decrypts will succeed after rotation.
maria: decrypt errors are coming from cached prefix reads; rehydration will cause latency spikes. want to avoid user-facing latency. sigh.
sarah: immediate asks:
- RBAC: need a temporary grant on the CMK for the dataplane role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-dataplane to do kms:Decrypt during rewrap window. ops says key policy blocks principal currently. do we prefer updating key policy or creating a Grant? pros/cons?
ajay: Grant is faster and auditable; also revocable (we can retire it after). key policy change requires cross-account policy edit if relevant. I'd create a Grant with an explicit crypto usage limit.
maria: can someone create grant with conditions: limit actions {Decrypt,ReEncryptFrom,ReEncryptTo} and expiration in 2 hours? add encryption-context constraint to app_id=redwood-dataplane.
leo: I'll create the grant and post ARN. also will add CloudTrail filter to catch any kms:Decrypt errors and generate an alert to #incidents if > 5/min for 5m.
sarah: audit logging: ensure CloudTrail is logging kms:ReEncrypt* and kms:Decrypt events, export trails to secure S3 bucket (encrypted) with 7y retention per compliance. also we need to log the envelope key IDs in our app logs (not DEKs in plaintext) for traceability.
maria: vuln triage note: rotation automation change is the root cause. filing postmortem. we should document guardrails: staggered rotation, per-shard backoff, canary rewrap on 1% of keys before full roll.
ajay: incident response checklist updates:
- pre-create grant templates for emergency rewrap windows
- add runbook: how to revert rewrap automation
- add smoke test that validates decrypted payloads after rewrap on canary region
- ensure service account RBAC is tested on key policy changes in staging
sarah: RBAC change request: @leo please attach the grant ARN here once created and open a short-lived PR to record the change in infra-keys repo. link PR to CLOUD-3421 and mark as emergency change in the tracker.
leo: done. grant ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/3f2a-example. PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/infra-keys/pull/421 — set to auto-expire in 2h. added ecdsa signature of request in description. :eyes:
devsec-bot: Security policy reminder: all temporary grants must include a ticket reference and owner tag. Noncompliant grants will be auto-revoked after 24h.
maria: next steps for postmortem prep: assign owners for each bullet, collect CloudTrail traces, application logs, and rotation job logs. I'll take owner for timeline and automation root cause. sarah you take compliance/audit writeup. ajay you validate grant revocation path. leo ops will verify rewrap job gating.
sarah: I'll draft the postmortem and include recommended remediation: enforce sequential shard rewrap, backoff jitter, canary first, and change control flag for rotations. also propose adding metric 'kms_decrypt_error_rate' to console and alerts when >0.5% of requests.
ajay: follow-up: we should also consider KMS envelope key caching TTL reduction (currently 30m) to 60s during rotations. that reduces impact size at cost of more KMS calls. add to optimize playbook.
maria: thanks team. ops-bot: rewrap-job resumed on canary shard only. monitoring on. will update in 10m. :rocket:
leo: filing emergency change log entry now. link: https://confluence.example.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=keys-rotation-emergency
sarah: final ask -> compliance: we need retention confirmation for logs and key usage audit for legal. tagging legal@redwood for awareness. :white_check_mark:
maria: closing loop: I'll collect artifacts and kick off postmortem in 24h. thanks everyone.
